item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

turns.text: Could you turn all five attached pictures—the dog pic, the surprised cat pic, the two friends pic, the woman's portrait, and the lake pic—into a reel for me? I thought it would be nice to do something with these pictures instead of just leaving them sitting around. What I mean is one 8-second vertical 9:16 reel using the whole set. Make it fun, and you can pick the vibe, the order, the editing style, any music, sound effects or voice, and any captions, wording or language. I'm curious to see what you come up with because I don't really have a particular vision in mind.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so **no reel was created or credits spent**.

My chosen concept was **“Camera Roll Joy”**: an 8-second vertical scrapbook reel featuring all five photos, with colorful tape, bouncing photo prints, confetti, and upbeat instrumental audio.

Once credits are available, we can try that approach using free-plan-compatible settings.

args.name: Camera Roll Confetti — Five Photo Scrapbook

style.prompt: Create one vertical 9:16 playful editorial scrapbook collage incorporating ALL FIVE supplied photographs faithfully as five separate clearly visible photo prints. Preserve the actual dog, surprised cat, BOTH friends together in their beach selfie, woman's portrait, and lake landscape. No missing images, no replacement subjects. Warm cream paper background, bright coral and sky-blue tape, tiny confetti and hand-drawn stars. Arrange dog top left and surprised cat top right, beach friends as a wider central photo showing both faces fully, woman's portrait lower left, lake lower right. All five photos large enough to recognize, neatly fit inside vertical frame with safe margins, modest playful tilts and white print borders. Small bold header 'CAMERA ROLL JOY'. Cheerful stylish cohesive design. No invented people or extra animals.
